svg.title: How governance as code works, from pull request to Unity Catalog and Ontos
svg.desc: Four steps, left to right. 1 Create: a Data Producer writes the data contract and the data product file, and opens a pull request. 2 Review and approve: CI checks the change against the standard and tries the quality rules, then a Data Steward approves and it merges. 3 Build: the deploy pipeline builds the product in dev, then in prod after an approval, with the quality rules running inside the pipeline. 4 Publish and sync: the publish pipeline checks the data matches the contract, then updates Unity Catalog and Ontos. Below, the four gates from draft (G1) to active (G4).

text.tspan: A data product moves through four gates, one at a time
